content: प्रेक्षा .²1 Viewing, seeing, beholding. .²2 A look, view, sight, appearance. .²3 Being a looker-on. .²4 Any public spectacle or show, sight. .²5 Particularly, a theatrical show, dramatic performance, play. .²6 Intellect, understanding. .²7 Reflection, consideration, deliberation; सा तस्मै सर्वमाचष्ट … … प्रत्युक्तं च यवकीतं प्रेक्षापूर्वं तथात्मना <ls>Mb. 3. 136. 7</ls>. .²8 The branch of a tree. .²9 Splendour; प्रेक्षां क्षिपन्तं हरितोपलाद्रेः <ls>Bhāg. 3. 8. 24</ls>.
